words.def: chosen as one of a small group of best candidates or suppliers for the final decision.
words.book: Well, if you are shortlisted, we will contact you for a panel interview within the next few days.
uses: Email
Good news: we've been shortlisted for the data-centre UPS tender at the bank.
Chat
we got shortlisted for the solar project 🎉
Meeting
Three suppliers were shortlisted; the final decision is next week.
dont: We entered the short list of the tender.
doo: We've been shortlisted for the tender.

words.def: the latest time or date by which something must be finished.
words.book: I have completed several client projects, including small consulting and research jobs, and delivered each job on budget and before the deadline.
uses: Email
Please note the deadline for submitting the quotation is Thursday at 3 pm.
Chat
what's the deadline for the battery replacement report?
Meeting
We can't miss this deadline — the client's site handover is on the 15th.
dont: We must finish before the last date.
doo: We need to meet the deadline.

words.def: while facing stress, urgency or a lot of work at the same time.
words.book: I can work well under pressure.
uses: Email
The service team handled the outage very well under pressure.
Chat
crazy day 😅 three UPS failures at once, but we're managing under pressure
Meeting
I work best under pressure — give me the urgent site visits.
dont: I can work under the pressure of work.

words.def: to give part of your work or responsibility to someone else in your team.
words.book: I am the type of manager who always delegates effectively.
uses: Email
I've delegated the preventive-maintenance schedule to Ahmed; please contact him directly.
Chat
can you delegate the invoices to someone? you're swamped
Meeting
I'll delegate the site survey to the junior engineers and review the results myself.
dont: I give my work to my team to do it.
doo: I delegate tasks to my team.

words.ar: يتوقع حاجة قبل ما تحصل ويستعد لها
words.def: to see a problem or need before it happens and prepare for it.
words.book: My ability to anticipate problems and explore alternative solutions has made me a decisive leader.
uses: Email
We anticipate a delay in the battery shipment due to customs clearance.
Chat
i'm anticipating a busy week with the summer load peaks ☀️
Meeting
We should anticipate the client's questions about the maintenance contract price.
dont: I expect the problems before they come.
doo: I anticipate problems before they happen.

words.ar: أهداف صعبة وطموحة أعلى من العادي
words.def: goals that are deliberately set higher than normal to push you to perform better.
words.book: I am goal-oriented and ambitious; I welcome goals and stretch targets because I really enjoy challenging work.
uses: Email
This year's sales plan includes a stretch target of EGP 20M for solar systems.
Chat
mgmt just sent the stretch targets for Q4 😬
Meeting
The base target is 100 UPS units; the stretch target is 130.
dont: I like the very high targets that are difficult.

upgrade.plain: Sorry, I am eating now, call me after.
upgrade.ar: آسف أنا باكل دلوقتي، كلمني بعدين
pro: I'm a little tied up just now. Is it OK if I call you back in half an hour?
Sorry, I eat now, call me after.
I am in the food, talk later.
upgrade.why: ‎call me after‎ ناقصة. قول ‎Is it OK if I call you back‎ وحدد الوقت.

upgrade.plain: I finished all projects before the dead time.
pro: I finished all projects before the dead time.
I finished all projects before the last time.
I delivered every project on time and on budget.
upgrade.why: الكلمة الصح ‎deadline‎، و‎on time and on budget‎ عبارة جاهزة.

upgrade.plain: I am very good in solving problems.
upgrade.ar: أنا شاطر جدًا في حل المشاكل
pro: I'm a problem-solver — I resolve issues quickly and logically.
I am very good in solving problems.
I solve the problems very good.
upgrade.why: ‎good at‎ مش ‎good in‎، و‎problem-solver‎ أقوى في المقابلة.

upgrade.plain: I want to learn more and take a higher position.
upgrade.ar: عايز أتعلم أكتر وآخد منصب أعلى
pro: I'm looking for a role where I can grow and take on more responsibility.
I want to be up in the company.
upgrade.why: ‎grow‎ و‎take on more responsibility‎ بتوصل الطموح بشكل مهني.

pro: What are the next steps in the process?
upgrade.why: في آخر المكالمة اسأل عن ‎the next steps‎ بدل سؤال عام.

upgrade.plain: I can work alone without anybody watch me.
upgrade.ar: أقدر أشتغل لوحدي من غير ما حد يراقبني
pro: I can work alone without anybody watch me.
I can work independently, without supervision.
upgrade.why: ‎work independently‎ و‎without supervision‎ هي الصيغة المهنية.
